fields.name: Human
fields.description: Humans are the most adaptable and ambitious people among the common races, found in every land and represented in every culture.
fields.traits: Versatile, adaptable, and ambitious. Humans have no innate magical abilities but make up for it with skill and determination.
fields.languages: Common, plus one extra language of your choice

fields.name: High Elf
fields.description: High elves have a keen mind and a mastery of at least the basics of magic. In many fantasy gaming worlds, there are two kinds of high elves: cold and reserved scholars, and adventurous wanderers in search of knowledge or magical power.
fields.traits: Darkvision 60 ft., Keen Senses (proficiency in Perception), Fey Ancestry (advantage against being charmed, immune to magical sleep), Trance (4 hours of meditation replaces sleep), Elf Weapon Training (longswords, shortswords, shortbows, longbows), Cantrip (one wizard cantrip of your choice; Intelligence is the spellcasting ability), Extra Language
fields.languages: Common, Elvish, plus one extra language of your choice

fields.name: Wood Elf
fields.description: Wood elves are quick, perceptive, and at home in the wilderness. They are folk of the deep forests, with senses honed by the hunt and reflexes sharpened by the trail.
fields.traits: Darkvision 60 ft., Keen Senses (proficiency in Perception), Fey Ancestry (advantage against being charmed, immune to magical sleep), Trance (4 hours of meditation replaces sleep), Elf Weapon Training (longswords, shortswords, shortbows, longbows), Fleet of Foot (base walking speed increases to 35 ft.), Mask of the Wild (can attempt to hide when only lightly obscured by foliage, weather, or natural phenomena)

fields.name: Hill Dwarf
fields.description: As a hill dwarf, you have keen senses, deep intuition, and remarkable resilience.
fields.traits: Darkvision 60 ft., Dwarven Resilience (advantage against poison, resistance to poison damage), Dwarven Combat Training (battleaxes, handaxes, light hammers, warhammers), Stonecunning (double proficiency on History checks related to stonework), Speed is not reduced by wearing heavy armor, Dwarven Toughness (HP maximum increases by 1, and increases by 1 every level)

fields.name: Mountain Dwarf
fields.description: Mountain dwarves are strong and hardy, accustomed to a difficult life in rugged terrain. They tend to be tall and stocky compared to other dwarves.
fields.traits: Darkvision 60 ft., Dwarven Resilience (advantage against poison, resistance to poison damage), Dwarven Combat Training (battleaxes, handaxes, light hammers, warhammers), Stonecunning (double proficiency on History checks related to stonework), Speed is not reduced by wearing heavy armor, Dwarven Armor Training (proficiency with light and medium armor)

fields.name: Lightfoot Halfling
fields.description: Lightfoots are more prone to wanderlust than other halflings, and often dwell alongside other races or take up a nomadic life. They are stealthy and friendly, with an easy adaptability to new surroundings.
fields.traits: Lucky (reroll natural 1s on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws), Brave (advantage on saving throws against being frightened), Halfling Nimbleness (can move through the space of any creature one size larger), Naturally Stealthy (can attempt to hide even when obscured only by a creature one size larger)

fields.name: Stout Halfling
fields.description: Stouts are hardier than other halflings and have some resistance to poison. Some say stouts have dwarven blood in their ancestry.
fields.traits: Lucky (reroll natural 1s on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws), Brave (advantage on saving throws against being frightened), Halfling Nimbleness (can move through the space of any creature one size larger), Stout Resilience (advantage on saving throws against poison, resistance to poison damage)

fields.name: Half-Elf
fields.description: Walking in two worlds but truly belonging to neither, half-elves combine what some say are the best qualities of their elf and human parents: human curiosity, inventiveness, and ambition tempered by the refined senses, love of nature, and artistic tastes of the elves.
fields.ability_score_increases: +2 Charisma, plus +1 to two other ability scores of your choice
fields.traits: Darkvision 60 ft., Fey Ancestry (advantage against being charmed, immune to magical sleep), Skill Versatility (proficiency in two skills of your choice)
fields.languages: Common, Elvish, plus one extra language of your choice

fields.name: Tiefling
fields.description: To be greeted with stares and whispers, to suffer violence and insult on the street, to see mistrust and fear in every eye: this is the lot of the tiefling. Their infernal heritage is undeniable, but their character is their own.
fields.traits: Darkvision 60 ft., Hellish Resistance (resistance to fire damage), Infernal Legacy (know the Thaumaturgy cantrip; at 3rd level, cast Hellish Rebuke once per day as a 2nd-level spell; at 5th level, cast Darkness once per day; Charisma is the spellcasting ability for these spells)

fields.name: Dragonborn
fields.description: Born of dragons, as their name proclaims, the dragonborn walk proudly through a world that greets them with fearful incomprehension. Dragonborn have a strong sense of honor, loyalty, and clan.
fields.traits: Draconic Ancestry (choose one: Black, Blue, Brass, Bronze, Copper, Gold, Green, Red, Silver, or White; this determines breath weapon and damage resistance), Breath Weapon (use your action to exhale destructive energy; shape, damage type, and save DC determined by ancestry; 2d6 damage at 1st level, scaling up with character level), Damage Resistance (resistance to the damage type associated with your draconic ancestry)

fields.name: Aasimar
fields.description: Aasimar bear within their souls the light of the heavens. They are descended from humans with a touch of the power of Mount Celestia, the divine realm of many lawful good deities. Their bond to the holy is no choice on their part, but a divine impulse stamped into their very being.
fields.traits: Darkvision 60 ft., Celestial Resistance (resistance to necrotic and radiant damage), Healing Hands (touch a creature as an action and heal hit points equal to your level once per long rest), Light Bearer (know the Light cantrip; Charisma is the spellcasting ability)

fields.name: Goliath
fields.description: At the highest mountain peaks, far above the slopes where trees grow and where the air is thin and the frigid winds howl, dwell the reclusive goliaths. Few folk can claim to have seen a goliath, and fewer still can claim friendship with one.
fields.traits: Natural Athlete (proficiency in the Athletics skill), Stone's Endurance (when taking damage, use your reaction to roll a d12 and reduce the damage by the roll plus your Constitution modifier, once per short or long rest), Powerful Build (count as one size larger when determining carrying capacity and weight you can push, drag, or lift), Mountain Born (acclimated to high altitude and cold climates)

fields.name: Tabaxi
fields.description: Hailing from a strange and distant land, wandering tabaxi are catlike humanoids driven by curiosity to collect interesting artifacts, gather tales and stories, and lay eyes on all the world's wonders.
fields.traits: Darkvision 60 ft., Feline Agility (when you move on your turn in combat, you can double your speed until the end of the turn; can't use this trait again until you move 0 feet on one of your turns), Cat's Claws (climbing speed of 20 ft., and claws are natural weapons dealing 1d4 slashing damage), Cat's Talent (proficiency in the Perception and Stealth skills)
fields.languages: Common, plus one extra language of your choice

fields.name: Fire Genasi
fields.description: With ash-colored skin, hair like living flame, and eyes that smolder like embers, fire genasi carry the spark of their elemental heritage in every gesture. They are passionate, quick-tempered, and as warm as the element that birthed them.
fields.traits: Darkvision 60 ft., Fire Resistance (resistance to fire damage), Reach to the Blaze (know the Produce Flame cantrip; at 3rd level, cast Burning Hands once per day as a 1st-level spell; Constitution is the spellcasting ability for these spells)

fields.name: Firbolg
fields.description: Firbolgs are forest guardians, gentle giants who live in seclusion among the deep woods. They prefer to avoid conflict, using their innate magic to hide and protect their forest homes from those who would do them harm.
fields.traits: Firbolg Magic (cast Detect Magic and Disguise Self once per short or long rest each; Wisdom is the spellcasting ability), Hidden Step (turn invisible as a bonus action until the start of your next turn or until you attack, make a damage roll, or force someone to make a saving throw; once per short or long rest), Powerful Build (count as one size larger when determining carrying capacity and weight you can push, drag, or lift), Speech of Beast and Leaf (limited communication with beasts and plants)

fields.name: Warforged
fields.description: Built as weapons of war to fight in the Last War, warforged are now seeking their own place in the world. They are sentient constructs of wood, metal, and stone, animated by living magic.
fields.ability_score_increases: +2 Constitution, +1 to one other ability score of your choice
fields.traits: Constructed Resilience (advantage on saving throws against being poisoned and resistance to poison damage; immunity to disease; don't need to eat, drink, or breathe; don't need to sleep, but can finish a long rest by remaining inactive for 6 hours), Sentry's Rest (during a long rest, must remain in an inactive, motionless state but remain conscious), Integrated Protection (+1 bonus to AC; can don and doff armor only during a rest), Specialized Design (proficiency in one skill and one tool of your choice)
fields.languages: Common, plus one extra language of your choice

fields.name: Orc
fields.description: Orcs are a proud and resilient people, shaped by a hard life and fierce traditions. Once considered savage by other races, orcs in the modern era reclaim their heritage as warriors, hunters, and protectors of their kin.
fields.traits: Darkvision 60 ft., Aggressive (as a bonus action, move up to your speed toward a hostile creature you can see), Powerful Build (count as one size larger when determining carrying capacity and weight you can push, drag, or lift), Primal Intuition (proficiency in two skills of your choice from Animal Handling, Insight, Intimidation, Medicine, Nature, Perception, and Survival)
